##### Project general facts

RA1N Residence is the debut architectural project of the development company Object 1, part of the international TSZ Group, and it was conceived as a work of contemporary art rather than simply another address. This striking twenty-five-storey tower wears a cool facade of light grey and white, while transparent blue elements, pools and water lines run through the interiors to bring a feeling of freshness and calm, like a sudden rain after the heat. The residence offers a beautifully composed choice of homes: one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom Pro layouts with a dedicated office or study, generous two-bedroom residences, podium villas with a private pool and terrace, and an exclusive Signature Collection on the top floor with terraces, jacuzzis and total privacy.

Every inch of the building has been designed around the well-being of its residents, beginning with a welcoming lobby that brings together a soft lounge and waiting area, a library wall, a common working space and a concierge on duty around the clock. The fourth-floor podium is a world of its own, with an outdoor swimming pool, a separate and safely divided children's pool, a baja shelf, cabanas and sun loungers, an indoor gym and fitness studio, an outdoor workout zone, and a club house for table tennis, football and good company. Families and friends are equally well served by indoor and outdoor kids play areas, a dining zone and BBQ area with an open-air kitchen and sunset views, a green recreation zone with a decorative water path, pergolas and benches, a landscaped back courtyard, two ground-floor shops, and a three-storey car park with a high-speed elevator, an EV charging station and shaded bicycle parking.

The apartments have been personally tested for everyday comfort, and it shows in the practical zoning, the clever storage systems, the high-quality finishes and the carefully considered lighting of every room. All cabinet-type furniture, from kitchens and wardrobes to bathroom units, comes from the celebrated Italian factories Arrital, Birex and Dall'Agnese, recognised worldwide as icons of style and technology and carrying international quality certificates with the 100% MADE IN ITALY label. Built-in kitchens and household appliances from leading manufacturers, spacious bathrooms with contemporary plumbing, bright living spaces that are never visually overloaded, and materials that simply call for your touch complete homes that feel effortlessly elegant and ready to live in right now.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, just next to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and near Dubai International Stadium, this exceptional location offers residents easy access to everything needed for everyday life. The community is strategically positioned near key destinations including Dubai Miracle Garden, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai International Airport.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to a wealth of amenities, including schools, medical facilities, convenience stores, shopping centres, and golf courses. The area offers direct access to the main highway, ensuring seamless connectivity to all parts of the city. Whether for work, leisure, or family life, every essential is within easy reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies luxury, convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
